subject: Sponsor mapping & procurement timeline — Redwood platform discovery
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & ask: platform discovery (next steps)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the asks so we can make progress this week: 

Key takeaways
- Primary use case: low-latency multi-tenant embeddings for product search across ~30M docs.
- Decision criteria you called out: latency SLOs, on-prem deployment options for sensitive datasets, and clear unit economics at 100k+ queries/day.
- Current blockers: procurement timelines and a security questionnaire that needs owner sign-off.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm who will be the budget owner / executive sponsor for this initiative (name & preferred email)?
2) What is your procurement timeline — any mandatory procurement windows or quarter boundaries we should be aware of?
3) Your procurement/security contact(s) that we should engage for the SOC 2 / data handling questions.

I attached my call notes (discovery-notes.pdf) and have a short ROI template I can populate if you share rough query volume / model choices. If it helps, we can do a 20-min intro with the sponsor + procurement to align decision criteria and timeline.

Proposed intro slots: Thu Apr 8, 10–11am PT or Fri Apr 9, 2–3pm PT. Let me know what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmeinc.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & ask: platform discovery (next steps)

Hi Evelyn —

Great summary, thanks. A few clarifications from my side:

Sponsor / budget owner
- Sarah Lee, VP of Platform (sarah.lee@acmeinc.com) is the executive sponsor and final budget approver. I’ll need to introduce you, she prefers a short two-paragraph intro that summarizes business impact and cost range.

Procurement / timeline
- Procurement runs monthly review cycles; our next formal review is the week of Apr 19. If we can get initial T&Cs + security answers in by Apr 15, Procurement can slot you for that review.

Security questions
- I’ve looped in procurement@acmeinc.com — they’ll want a completed security questionnaire (we use a short spreadsheet) and an IP/data handling summary. I’m attaching their initial question list so you can see the scope.

A couple of asks for you:
- Can you send an intro email to Sarah and Procurement with a one-paragraph value statement and proposed next steps?
- Can you provide an expected cost range (order of magnitude) for the configuration we discussed (dedicated capacity vs hosted fallback) so Sarah has something to react to?

Thanks — I’ll coordinate scheduling once we have a proposed intro and rough numbers.

Alex
Senior Engineering Manager, Search — Acme, Inc.
Attachment: initial-questions.xlsx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmeinc.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps: Redwood x Acme platform evaluation

Hi Sarah / Procurement team —

Alex kindly looped me in. Very pleased to meet you all. Short introduction and next steps below.

Why Redwood is relevant (one paragraph)
Redwood Inference is a developer-first inference platform optimized for predictable latency and cost at scale. For companies operating high-volume search, we offer dedicated GPU pools, transparent per-token/embedding economics, and private deployment options so sensitive data never leaves your VPC.

Proposed next steps
- Procurement: we will complete and return your security questionnaire within 3 business days of receipt (Evelyn to own).
- Exec sponsor (Sarah): we’ll send a 1-slide ROI summary and an order-of-magnitude cost range for both dedicated capacity and a hosted fallback.
- Scheduling: propose a 30-min alignment call week of Apr 12 or Apr 19 — Procurement suggested Apr 19 slot is the next formal review.

Immediate asks for Sarah (to speed the process)
- Would you prefer a short ROI email (1–2 bullets + numbers) or a 30-min walkthrough to approve the budget?
- Any procurement constraints (purchase order, specific contract language, or legal redlines) we should be aware of?

I’ve attached a blank ROI template and I’ll fill it with your numbers as soon as you share approximate monthly query volume and desired SLOs.

Thanks and speak soon —
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: roi-template.pdf

1) Karthik: can you draft the high-level cost ranges (dedicated vs hosted fallback) by EOD today? Keep ranges broad (e.g., $X–$Y per month) — we’ll tighten after we get volume.
2) Priya: please queue up the SOC 2 / data handling summary and the security questionnaire template — I’ll populate with Acme specifics once they return the initial-questions.xlsx.

I plan to send the intro to Sarah & procurement now (copying you both).

Thanks —
